PROP-1ada093f-asm-001.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all transaction data from P2P must be fully validated before state access.
PROP-1ada093f-asm-001.assertion: forall p2p_msg(peer, tx_bytes): decode_transaction(tx_bytes) AND validate_transaction(tx) before any state mutation

locations.note: Transaction validator enforces validation before pool acceptance. All P2P transactions go through validation.
